Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer reported that H ctor Rebaque had one Formula One podium based on the metadata of a webpage and its summary, which was incorrect. In actuality, H ctor Rebaque never achieved any podium finishes in Formula One. The mistake occurred because WebSurfer relied on erroneous data from a non-authoritative source without verifying it against more credible sources (such as Formula1.com or officially curated databases). This failure to validate the data perpetuated an incorrect conclusion in subsequent steps.
